title: Canva Pro & Figma E-Commerce Visuals & Ad Creative Suite
summary: Multi-format commercial visual marketing suite engineered in Figma and Canva Pro, featuring high-converting 4:5 and 2:3 portrait ad creatives, exploded food infographics, and 3D kinetic product drops.
problem: E-commerce brands and local restaurants struggle to stop feed scrolling and generate buyer clicks when relying on low-effort generic photos without clear visual hierarchy, ingredient callouts, and strategic price anchors.
whatIDid: Engineered dynamic 3D kinetic e-commerce product ads (Volt Run X1) with neon speed-trail motion blur, electric magenta lighting, and friction-free 'Shop Now' call-to-actions.
Formulated 3-step ingredient callout infographics for food & beverage brands (Tala Coffee Co. & Stackhouse Burgers) breaking down premium layers to drive organic saves and shares.
Composed luxury tactile lifestyle compositions (Haven & Wick soy candles) balancing raw terracotta textures, scent profile notes, and burn-time specifications.
Illustrated high-concept editorial book covers (The Door in the Oak) using multi-plane papercut woodland vector layers with illuminated focal points.

Designed high-converting event and workshop marketing posters (Golden Hour Music Festival & Focus Lab Study Workshop) featuring nostalgic 70s typography, flatlay study arrangements, and scarcity-driven registration triggers.
result: Generated 24,300+ organic monthly impressions with $0 ad spend across active Pinterest affiliate channels and established standardized ad templates for rapid product launch turnaround.
